page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.small is an entry-tier compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by a custom Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor utilizing the arm64 architecture. Hardware resources include 1 dedicated vCPU mapped directly to 1 physical core clocked at 2.75 GHz with 1 thread per core. The processor includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 64 MB of shared L3 cache, alongside hardware cryptographic acceleration supporting standard AES instructions.

System memory consists of 2.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio characteristic of compute-optimized instances. The instance provisions no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operational disk needs. Network capability is capped at a 1 Gbps baseline throughput without bundled public IPv4 addresses, and no GPU hardware accelerators are present on the platform.

Benchmark results demonstrate modest capability constrained by the single-core topology. In single-core stress-ng tests, the instance records an average score of 1773.69, which matches its multi-core outcome due to the single-thread limit. Memory throughput is modest, exhibiting 18.96 GB/sec sequential uncached read speeds and 7.51 GB/sec write speeds. Algorithmic compression tests achieve standard execution rates, with gzip processing at 27.84 GB/sec and bzip3 decompressing at 10.24 GB/sec. Complex operations show bottom-decile scores, including a PassMark CPU score of 836.56, Redis SET throughput of 1.53 million operations per second, and small-model (135M) language inference at 44.11 generated tokens per second.

Given its minimal footprint and dedicated ARM core, ecs.c8y.small provides a cost-effective operational floor for workloads requiring predictable dedicated clock rates without heavy multi-threading. It is technically suitable for light microservices, utility tasks, low-volume background workers, and automated continuous integration testing targeted specifically at ARM64 environments.

The instance provides 1 dedicated physical core running at 2.75 GHz, backed by 2.0 GB of system memory, 64 MB of L3 cache, and a 1 Gbps baseline network throughput. No local storage or discrete GPU accelerators are bundled with the hardware. Benchmark evaluation demonstrates competent single-thread performance, delivering 1773.69 in stress-ng tests and 27.84 GB/sec in gzip compression, though absolute throughput remains low due to the single-core configuration. Memory bandwidth reaches 18.96 GB/sec for uncached reads and 7.51 GB/sec for writes. The ecs.c8y.small is technically appropriate for lightweight microservices, continuous integration agents, lightweight proxy servers, and low-traffic utility workloads compiled for ARM64 targets.
